summary_1line: Rama, Lakshmana, and Sugriva journey toward Kishkindha and pause to revere the mysterious hermitage of the ascetic Saptajanas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana places a bright garland of blossoming Gajapushpi flowers around Sugriva’s neck as a mark for Rama to recognize him in battle.
Rama, Lakshmana, and the monkey chiefs gaze toward a mysterious forest grove whose treetops are veiled in golden smoke from the sages’ sacred fires.
Rama and Lakshmana stand with joined palms, offering reverence toward the hidden hermitage of the seven ascetics surrounded by silent, sacred woods.
